layer: answer quality — the four RAGAS metric definitions, implemented in this repository

metric_source.why: the `ragas` package is not installed in this repository or on this machine, and the answering path is deliberately dependency-free; the definitions are implemented in scripts/eval_answer_quality.py

definitions.faithfulness: supported statements / statements in the answer
definitions.answer_relevancy: mean cosine(question, question generated from the answer)
definitions.context_precision: average precision over cited chunks judged useful
definitions.context_recall: reference claims attributable to the contexts / reference claims

metric_source.comparability: scores are NOT comparable to a `ragas` library run: the prompt, the decomposition and the call pattern are this repository's
metric_source.call_pattern: one structured judge call per question plus one batched embedding call, because this key's free tier allows 20 requests per window

caveats: faithfulness is near 1.0 by construction when the answer is a selection of quoted corpus paragraphs — it measures the contract, not the retrieval's judgement
the judge is one model at temperature 0; a different judge would move these numbers
the free tier throttles, so the run is resumable rather than fast: a question is scored once and skipped on the next run
